- docs/plans/claude-fixer-unattended-convergence-plan.md (lines 482-485) | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The duplicate-resume guard for `/reclarify` relies on a fresh session discovering the stage session ID of an already-running stage session. The plan says "the stage session id the checker records" but does not specify where the checker records it such that a fresh `/reclarify` session can discover it. The existing progress log format (`.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` line 272: `Check-in: checker <session id>   safety net <trig_…>   hand-back <trig_… | none>`) records the checker's session id but not the stage session id. The `— resume.` block (line 217: `Previous stage session: <stage session id>`) carries the stage session id, but a fresh `/reclarify` session starts without a `— resume.` block — it reads the progress log. Without a specified recording location, the implementation cannot build the guard as described, and the "Done when" criteria ("the command-doc tests asserting both") cannot be written.
  WHY: When the checker starts a stage (step 5 of the checker prompt, line 214) and a human simultaneously comments `/reclarify` in issue mode, the `/reclarify` session reads the progress log, finds `Stage: <stage>` but no stage session id to check liveness against. The guard cannot fire, so two sessions may both run the same stage.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
